extra.reason: Resolved: the project owner confirmed that “five” was a typo; initial scope is the four named package types.
Completed initial four-protocol compatibility matrix with client floors, routes, metadata, exclusions, HTTP rules, and authoritative references.
Captured sanitized local request fixtures for PyPI, dnf5, apt, and pacman, including archive flows and credential/challenge behavior; documented limitations and follow-on test requirements.
Initial four-protocol scope, compatibility matrix, and representative sanitized request fixtures are complete.
Completed transparent registry-forwarding, challenge relay, header, redirect, cache, and explicit non-MVP broker-mode contract; created GHCR direct-auth validation task.
Defined canonical reversible repository locator, strict validation, direct exact-name OCI forwarding invariant, public URL grammar, protocol examples, and negative-test requirements.
Completed strict v1 OCI layout, route-map, signing preservation, publication lifecycle, cache, trust, and integrity contract; created resolver and publisher validation work.
Completed upstream-boundary threat model with trust boundaries, mitigations, verification evidence, normative transport policy, residual risks, and standards sources.
Completed typed allowlist observability, secret exclusions, repository privacy, safe error/correlation/debug/panic policy, and required canary/fuzz/CI gates.
Completed typed HTTP status, cache, validator, HEAD, and conservative Range contract for immutable descriptor-mapped package representations.
Published layout v1 example envelope, route-map skeleton, client-facing mappings, expected HTTP behavior, and executable valid/invalid fixture matrix for the implementation corpus.

Implemented the pinned Rust 1.88.0 workspace foundation with an explicitly feature-minimized Tokio/Hyper streaming stack, a lockfile, workspace safety lints, build-output ignore rule, and documented MSRV/dependency rationale. Verified cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo test, release build, and no-output process smoke test with the pinned toolchain.

Implemented the raw v1 route parser and typed ValidatedRepository/ValidatedRoute boundary. It accepts only GET/HEAD /r/v1/<canonical-base64url-locator>/<pypi|rpm|apt|pacman>/<canonical-path>, preserves exact decoded repository bytes and trailing-slash path identity, supports explicit frontend enablement, and exposes only safe error classifications. Unit and property tests cover all four protocol bases, canonical round trips, unsupported methods, malformed/noncanonical locators, invalid repository spellings, percent escapes and decoded separators, query/fragment/control/backslash rejection, dot/repeated/parameter paths, disabled frontends, and bounded inputs. Verified cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo test, release build, and process smoke test.

Implemented inbound admission checks and bounded body support. Added typed input-free errors, request-target/header count+byte limits, strict GET/HEAD read-only framing, invalid/conflicting Content-Length rejection, Transfer-Encoding/Expect/Upgrade rejection, origin-form enforcement through the existing raw route parser, and a Limited body wrapper for future consumers. Added negative/unit tests for malformed routes, oversized target and headers, control bytes, framing smuggling cases, unsupported methods, unexpected bodies, and body-limit exhaustion. Verified cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, and cargo build --workspace --release.

Implemented typed credential-safe proxy errors and response mapping. Added fixed non-disclosing JSON responses for inbound, route, upstream, timeout, cancellation, and unexpected failures; preserved only validated WWW-Authenticate and Retry-After semantics; added redaction-focused snapshot and classification tests. cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, workspace tests, and release build pass.

Implemented a reusable loopback-only programmable OCI Distribution fixture under tests/support. It serves exact repository-scoped manifests/blobs, matches method/path/selected headers without retaining sensitive values, supports public/private auth challenges and exact credential checks, HEAD, ETag/304, bounded single ranges, delayed large streams, explicit status faults, and truncated Content-Length responses. Added redaction-focused integration coverage and documented the harness. cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, workspace tests, and release build pass.

Implemented and verified deterministic package/OCI fixture corpus, native metadata, malformed cases, generator/verifier documentation, and Rust regression tests. Python archive/hash checks plus cargo fmt, clippy, workspace tests, and release build pass.
